method.eligibility: Union of original timing prerequisite panel (passed, fully graded) and common all-topic panel (all outcomes and activity types except diagnostics), ordinal delta >=2. Each event lists its panels.
method.identity: Account and course and topic; one row event can have multiple separately assessed course contexts.
method.restoration: Previous peak >=4, before <=2, after >= previous peak minus 1; exact equality is also recorded. Other-course history is reported separately and never substituted for same-course state.
method.followup: Unique (course, capture timestamp, topic, band) observations for six hours after the jump, stopping at the next captured diagnostic. No duplicate baseline reads count twice.
method.scope: Previously frozen file manifest only; no future or uncaptured events are inferred.

activity_type_comparison.method: All-topic common scope: same course-ID/topic pairs, agreeing repeated-course displays collapsed once, before bands 1–5, intervals at most 30 minutes with exactly one captured activity and the candidate event inside the interval. Current baselines precede the first answer. Outcomes and grading do not select tasks; completed assessment observations are included even without a task pass/fail label.
